The '''3rd age felling axe''' is a type of [[felling axe]] requiring an [[Attack]] level of 65 to be equipped, and a [[Woodcutting]] level of 61 to be used. Players can create the axe by using a [[felling axe handle]] on a [[3rd age axe]] while having a [[hammer]] in their inventory and standing next to an [[anvil]]; this process is '''irreversible''', but the felling axe itself remains tradeable.

3rd age felling axes will chop at the same speed as a normal 3rd age axe. If the player is carrying [[forester's ration]]s however (either in the inventory or inside a [[forestry kit]]), they will receive 10% more Woodcutting experience each time they successfully chop a tree and gain a 20% chance not to receive logs when chopping trees (or [[Tree roots (Forestry)|tree roots]] in the [[Forestry#Rising_Roots|Rising Roots]] forestry event), at the cost of consuming one ration. This also results in a 20% chance to not receive [[anima-infused bark]] from tree roots.

If the player has no rations on their person, the felling axe will function like a regular 3rd age axe.

==Special attack==
The 3rd age felling axe has a [[special attacks|special attack]], ''Lumber Up'', that it shares with the [[Dragon axe|dragon]], [[Infernal axe|infernal]], [[3rd age axe|3rd age]], and [[Crystal axe|crystal axes]] and their variants. It [[Temporary skill boost|temporarily boosts]] the player's [[Woodcutting]] level by 3, consuming 100% of the player's special attack energy. The boost degrades every 60 seconds, with the player's Woodcutting level returning to normal after 3 minutes. Using [[Preserve]] can increase the duration by 50%.

The special attack can be used to allow players to chop with the axe itself starting at level 58 Woodcutting, although it cannot be used without the level 65 [[Attack]] required to wield the axe.

Note that any levels boosted above 99 with the special attack will be treated as 99. Therefore, you will start to receive diminishing returns with the special attack at level 97 and 98{{CiteTwitter|author=Mod Ash|url=https://twitter.com/JagexAsh/status/1375844352098975753|date=27 March 2021|archiveurl=https://archive.ph/5piyY|archivedate=29 March 2021}}, with visible boosts past level 99 only influencing the [[Pet#Skilling pets|pet]] and [[clue nest]] chances.{{CiteTwitter|author=Mod Ash|url=https://twitter.com/JagexAsh/status/1573018832998109185|date=22 September 2022|archiveurl=https://archive.is/Ym89y|archivedate=10 June 2023|quote=The formula for dropping clue nests only benefits from visible boosts. So the +7 invisible one won't help, but a visible boost would help beyond 99 if you can get one.}}

The 3rd age felling axe is a type of felling axe requiring an Attack level of 65 to be equipped, and a Woodcutting level of 61 to be used. Players can create the axe by using a felling axe handle on a 3rd age axe while having a hammer in their inventory and standing next to an anvil; this process is irreversible, but the felling axe itself remains tradeable.

3rd age felling axes will chop at the same speed as a normal 3rd age axe. If the player is carrying forester's rations however (either in the inventory or inside a forestry kit), they will receive 10% more Woodcutting experience each time they successfully chop a tree and gain a 20% chance not to receive logs when chopping trees (or tree roots in the Rising Roots forestry event), at the cost of consuming one ration. This also results in a 20% chance to not receive anima-infused bark from tree roots.

If the player has no rations on their person, the felling axe will function like a regular 3rd age axe.

This item can be stored in the treasure chest of a costume room, provided that the interface of the corresponding clue tier is opened before attempting to store the item. Alternatively, the item can be used on the opened treasure chest to insert it without viewing the interface.

Special attack

[edit | edit source]

The 3rd age felling axe has a special attack, Lumber Up, that it shares with the dragon, infernal, 3rd age, and crystal axes and their variants. It temporarily boosts the player's Woodcutting level by 3, consuming 100% of the player's special attack energy. The boost degrades every 60 seconds, with the player's Woodcutting level returning to normal after 3 minutes. Using Preserve can increase the duration by 50%.

The special attack can be used to allow players to chop with the axe itself starting at level 58 Woodcutting, although it cannot be used without the level 65 Attack required to wield the axe.

Note that any levels boosted above 99 with the special attack will be treated as 99. Therefore, you will start to receive diminishing returns with the special attack at level 97 and 98[1], with visible boosts past level 99 only influencing the pet and clue nest chances.[2]
